closable_paths_counted: Build the ten measured Tool families
verdict: The measured closure paths total 48,414 against a gap of 31,703, so on paper they cover it. They are NOT interchangeable with built pages: every one is an upper bound on ROWS and the gates still apply per row, and the largest of them is rate-limited upstream rather than blocked by this code. Treat the total as a ceiling to work towards, not as a number already earned.
